source: FORCE_PER_EPISODE.csv (derived from observation.force ch12-15 of all 845 episodes)
findings: Every episode contains genuine pad contact (contact_frac 0.45-0.60 of frames).

L_in and L_out maxima are nearly identical per episode (medians 1.442 vs 1.447 N), so both left pads are live in the recordings - the earlier live-run L_in=0 result was run-specific, not a dead channel.
Right pads are exactly 0 in all 845 episodes (task executes with the left arm), confirming the dataset's force coverage is left-only.
